fair_value.method: Blend of a conservative intrinsic SOTP ($5.6), a peer/strategic-multiple SOTP ($10.7), a 2027 run-rate EV/sales check ($6.9) and a 10% weight on the consensus analyst target ($24.15). All use ~331M pro forma basic shares (249.97M + ~14.8M ASM + 65.85M VAC) and ~$0.885B net claims at the VAC close (~$0.75B net debt plus the ~$135M Ara preferred, which is near-certain to be issued with the stock far below $20.93). The $700M converts at $20.34 are treated as debt.

methods.name: SOTP
methods.inputs: Conservative intrinsic NAV. Uranium $850M (~1.8-2.0M lb/yr at ~$85 realized vs ~$40/lb all-in cost, ~$90M/yr EBITDA over a limited mine life, plus pipeline). REE portfolio $800M risked (White Mesa Phase 1B/1C $300M, Donald earn-in $150M with FID still not taken, Vara Mada/Bahia $150M, ASM Dubbo + Korean Metals Plant $200M). VAC $1.3B, down from $1.4B: ~$90M 2028E EBITDA x ~14.5, because the supervisor showed that $65-75M is a Sumter run-rate and not a group guide, so 2027 is ~$60-90M. Vanadium/HMS/isotopes $50M. Capitalized overhead -$300M. EV ~$2.7B less $0.885B net claims = ~$1.85B / 331M sh.

methods.name: SOTP
methods.inputs: Peer/strategic-premium SOTP. Uranium $1.2B (~1.0x P/NAV at the $96.50 LT price plus a premium as the largest US producer). REE $1.5B. VAC at the deal EV of $2.04B ($1.9B equity + $140M net debt). Overhead -$300M. EV $4.44B less $0.885B net claims = $3.55B / 331M sh.

methods.name: EV/sales
methods.inputs: 2027E run-rate pro forma revenue ~$635M: uranium ~1.8M lb x $85 = ~$150M, REE ~$20M, and VAC ~$465M (a third-party estimate of ~EUR400M; the company discloses only EBITDA). Multiplied by 5.0x = $3.18B EV, less $0.885B net claims = $2.29B / 331M sh.

methods.name: other
methods.inputs: Consensus 12-month analyst target (8 analysts, Strong Buy; BMO $18, Roth $16, HCW $29.25). Kept at a low weight because most targets predate the sector de-rating.

bear.story: The US-China thaw keeps deflating the rare-earth premium. VAC closes at ~70x trailing EBITDA with the Ara preferred issued and a 19.9% holder overhang. The OSC loan stalls, so REE capex is funded through ATM/equity at low prices. Donald FID keeps slipping, uranium drifts to the $70s, and 2027 stays loss-making. The stock trades at or below conservative NAV (~$5-6).

base.story: VAC closes in 2027-Q1, ASM is integrated, and the OSC loan is eventually finalized. Uranium holds $85-95 spot with LT ~$96 and ~2M lb at ~$23-30/lb cost. Heavy-REE circuits stay on track for late 2027 and Donald FID lands in late 2026 or early 2027. The market values the company a little below a peer-multiple SOTP, with ~331M shares, $700M converts and the preferred capping the upside.

bull.story: Trade tensions re-flare or new Chinese export controls arrive. US support (OSC loan finalized, price floors/offtakes like MP/DoD) re-rates Western mine-to-magnet platforms. Sumter shows a path to 4,000 tpa ($130-140M EBITDA), uranium LT exceeds $100, and the stock recovers toward the $18-24 analyst range.

thesis_break_reason: Around $6.2 the equity is worth ~$2.05B on 331M shares, which with ~$0.885B of net claims is an EV of ~$2.9B. That is roughly my conservative intrinsic SOTP, with nothing for REE optionality and VAC below the price being paid. A sustained move there would most likely mean something fundamental broke: the VAC close failed or was renegotiated, the conditional OSC loan fell through and forced a large discounted equity raise, heavy-REE construction or Donald feed stalled, or uranium fell below ~$65/lb.

reasoning: Round 2 revision. The supervisor's fact-check showed that my round-1 net debt (~$0.65B) left out ~$100M of burn/capex to close, the ~$24M ASM cash component and the VAC net debt handling. Verified: $936.7M cash+securities at 6/30, less $718M VAC cash, ASM cash and burn, leaves ~$95M against $700M converts and $140M VAC net debt, so ~$0.75B net debt. The Ara preferred (up to $135M if the price is below $20.93 at close, confirmed in the deal release) should also be counted, since spot is $11.35. That gives ~$0.885B of net claims and cuts every EV-based method by ~$0.7/share. My ~15M ASM share assumption was confirmed (0.053 x ~279M ASM shares = ~14.8M; 65.853M VAC shares = 19.9% implies ~331M). I also trimmed conservative VAC value slightly because $65-75M is a Sumter run-rate and not 2027 group EBITDA, and I now label VAC revenue (~EUR400M) as a third-party estimate. My searches confirmed that the OSC loan is still conditional (no definitive agreement), that Donald FID was targeted for Q3 2026 and has not been announced, that uranium spot is ~$90 in the week of 9/22, and that the stock bounced to $12.30 on 9/21 before falling back to $11.35. The methods now give $5.6 / $10.7 / $6.9 plus the $24.15 consensus at 10% weight, so the blended fair value is ~$9.7, ~15% below spot. In round 1 I put the median (~$11) above my fair value. With fair value now further below spot and the added dilution overhangs (preferred, 19.9% holder, conditional OSC), I moved the median down to ~$10.6. That is still above fair value, because sell-side support, policy optionality (this name has doubled on export-control headlines) and a cash-generative uranium core argue against pricing it at NAV. The distribution is lognormal with sigma ~0.70, below the 89% trailing realized volatility since part of that came from the 2025 mania, but still wide for binary policy and financing catalysts. The result is P(>= $11.35) = 0.46, ~26% below $6.81 and ~18.5% above $19.86. The bear/base/bull prices of 5.5 / 10.5 / 20 at 25/50/25% fit the ladder. I did not use option-market data or anything under priors/. I do not dispute any supervisor finding. My independent median call happens to land close to its mean ladder.
